title.narrative: Youth address gender stereotypes and promote gender equality

description.narrative: The project aims to change public opinion and actions in the three biggest cities in Vietnam towards equality between men and women in all spheres of life. In order for new gender attitudes and practices to stick, people need to be informed and inspired, apply new behaviours repeatedly, and be recognized for their contributions to their family, community and society.
